steps_raw.instruction: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid III (ACSF.III)
Scope and Applicability: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid III (ACSF.III) is used for applications including tissue bath solution during electrophysiological recording.
Calcium Chloride, dihydrate (CaCl2·2 H2O) (Sigma C3881, Sigma C3306 or equivalent)
D-Glucose (C6H12O6; aka Dextrose) (Sigma G7021 or equivalent)
Magnesium Sulfate, Heptahydrate (MgSO4·7 H2O) (Sigma M1880 or equivalent)
Sodium Phosphate monobasic monohydrate (NaH2PO4 • H2O) (Sigma S9638 or equivalent)
Potassium Chloride (KCl) (Sigma P9333, Sigma P5405 or equivalent)
Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO3) (Sigma S5761 or equivalent)
Sodium Chloride (NaCl) (JT Baker 4058 purchased as VWR JT4058 or equivalent)
1N NaOH (VWR BDH3222-1 or equivalent)
Picrotoxin (C30H34O13) (Abcam ab120315 preferred, Sigma P1675 or equivalent)
Kynurenic Acid (C10H7NO3) (Sigma K3375 preferred, Tocris 0223, or equivalent)
1 Liter polystyrene bottle (VWR 28199-762 or equivalent)
500 mL polystyrene bottle (VWR 28199-760 or equivalent)
250 mL polystyrene bottle (VWR 28199-758 or equivalent)
1000 mL graduated cylinder
100 mL graduated cylinder

25 mL serological pipette (VWR 53300-567 or equivalent)
10 mL Serological pipette (VWR 53300-523 or equivalent)

Osmometer (Fiske 210, Advanced Instruments 3250, or equivalent)
Magnetic stir bar remover
Calibrated powder balance
1 Liter volumetric flask
Wipe down powder hood surfaces with MilliQ water before and after use.
Caution: Picrotoxin is highly toxic and special handling is required
Prevent skin and eye exposure by wearing double-gloves, lab coat, sleeve protectors, safety glasses and face shield.
Weigh the powder on a balance in a fume hood. Limit traffic in the immediate area while handling this chemical.
Mix the solution on a stir plate in a powder hood.
Decontaminate surfaces after working with Picrotoxin, using a 10% bleach solution.
Wash hands after handling Picrotoxin.
Caution: Kynurenic acid is an irritant.
Prevent skin and eye exposure by wearing double-gloves, lab coat, sleeve protectors, safety glasses and face shield.
Weigh the powder on a balance in a fume hood. Limit traffic in the immediate area while handling this chemical.
Mix the solution on a stir plate in a powder hood.
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
500 mL or 1 liter of Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid III (ACSF.III) Ph 7.3, Osmolarity 300-310 mOsm containing:
2.0 mM Calcium Chloride, dihydrate
1 mM Magnesium Sulfate, Heptahydrate
1.25 mM Sodium Phosphate monobasic monohydrate
2.5 mM Potassium Chloride
26 mM Sodium Bicarbonate
126 mM Sodium Chloride
EQ0006 pH Meter Calibration and Usage
EQ0020 Balance Calibration Validation
PF0284 Measuring Osmolarity with the Vapro 5600 Osmometer
PF0302 Measuring Osmolarity with the Advanced Instruments 3250 Osmometer
PF0078 Operation and Maintenance of Advanced Instruments OsmoTECH
Prepare working stocks of reagents, as necessary. Label the stock bottles with contents, preparer’s initials, preparation date, storage requirement and expiration date.
Calcium Chloride, dihydrate: Prepare a 200 mM stock solution by dissolving 29.4 g of CaCl2·2 H2O in 1 Liter of MilliQ Water in a labeled 1 Liter sterile polystyrene bottle.
Label bottle as ‘200 mM Calcium Chloride’, date, and preparer’s initials. Store the stock solution at room temperature for up to 60 days.
Prepare a 250 mM Potassium Chloride, 125 mM Sodium Phosphate monobasic monohydrate, 100 mM Magnesium Sulfate Heptahydrate solution.
Prepare a 50 mM stock solution of Potassium Chloride by dissolving 18.6 g of KCl in 1 Liter of MilliQ Water in a labeled 1 Liter sterile polystyrene bottle.
Add 17.3 g of NaH2PO4 to the Potassium Chloride solution.
Add 24.6 g of MgSO4.7 H2O to the Potassium Chloride / Sodium Phosphate Solution.
Label bottle as ‘Super Stock’, date, and preparer’s initials. Store the stock solution at room temperature for up to 60 days.
Sodium Chloride: Prepare a 4 M stock solution by dissolving 233.8 g of NaCl in 1 Liter of MilliQ Water in a labeled 1 Liter sterile polystyrene bottle.
Label bottle as ‘4 M NaCl’, date, and preparer’s initials. Store the stock solution at room temperature for up to 60 days.
Methodology/Procedures (record all lot numbers and volumes used in the appropriate reagent prep notebook):
ACSF.III has a shelf life of one week, stored at 4°C.
Consult the reagent request form to determine the volume of ACSF to prepare. Table 1 lists the reagent quantities required to make either 500 mL or 1 Liter of ACSF.
To make 1000 mL of Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid III (ACSF.III):
Using a graduated cylinder, measure 500 mL of MilliQ Water. Add the water to an appropriately labeled RNase free container containing an RNase free stir bar.
Place the container on a stir plate and begin stirring at a high setting (7 or higher).
Using a sterile serological pipette, add 10 mL of the 250 mM Potassium Chloride / 125 mM Sodium Phosphate / 100 mM Magnesium Sulfate stock solution.
Using a sterile serological pipette, add 31.5 mL of the 4 M Sodium Chloride stock solution.
Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 2.25 g of D-Glucose. Slowly add weighed D-Glucose to the container while stirring.
Weigh out 2.184 g of Sodium Bicarbonate. Slowly add weighed Sodium Bicarbonate to the container while stirring.
Continue stirring at a high speed (setting 7 or higher) until all of the chemicals are fully in solution.
Using a calibrated meter, measure the pH of the ACSF solution. If necessary, adjust the pH to 7.3 with HCl or NaOH.
Using a sterile serological pipette, add 10 mL of the 200 mM Calcium Chloride stock solution.
Adjust final volume to 1000 mL with MilliQ Water using a volumetric flask.
Measure the osmolarity the solution using an osmometer.

If using a 3250 Freezing Point Osmometer, measure the osmolarity of a 250 µL sample of the solution or if using the OsmoTECH, measure 20 µL of the solution; if the osmolarity is not 300-310 mOsm (300-310 mmol/kg), adjust as needed. Refer to PF0302 for the 3250 Osmometer, or PF0078 for the OsmoTECH for operation instructions.

If utilizing a Vapro 5600 Osmometer, measure the osmolarity of a 10 µL sample of the solution. Refer to PF0284 for Vapro 5600 operation instructions. If the osmolarity is not 295-305 mOsm (295-305 mmol/kg), adjust as needed.
If the osmolarity is too high, add MilliQ water.
If the osmolarity is too low, add a volume (X) of 1 mg/mL NaCl solution determined by the following equation
O= observed osmolarity
X=volume of 1 mg/mL NaCl solution to add (in mL)
Confirm that the correct osmolarity has been reached after addition of NaCl or water.
Filter the ACSF through a Corning 1 liter 0.45 µm filter system or directly into the final sterile bottle.
Using Tygon tubing, attach the Corning filter system to the Gast vacuum pump. Turn on the pump.
Filter 500 mL at a time, stirring the remaining ACSF constantly on a stir plate.
Label the final bottle with reagent name, date, time and preparer’s initials. ACSF expires one week from date of preparation.
Place the bottle of filtered ACSF on a stir plate in a fume hood.
Review the safety information about Picrotoxin and Kynurenic Acid in Section 4.
Put on a face shield, sleeve protectors and a second pair of gloves. Turn on the powder hood and allow the system to run for 15 minutes before using.
Weigh out 60 mg of Picrotoxin using a balance in a fume hood. Slowly add weighed Picrotoxin to the container while stirring.
Weigh out 189 mg of Kynurenic Acid using a balance in a fume hood. Slowly add weighed Kynurenic Acid to the container while stirring.
Continue stirring until Picrotoxin and Kynurenic Acid have dissolved. This can take over an hour.
Record the date of preparation, lot numbers of all components, and osmolarity in the online Laboratory Documentation form.

Dispose of excess reagents directly into municipal sewer system. Per EHS, ACSF with solid Kynurenic Acid and Picrotoxin can be poured directly into the municipal sewer system, if the Picrotoxin makes up less than 0.01% of the waste and concentration is <0.001%. At 60 mL/L in this SOP, it is acceptable to pour down the drain. If higher concentrations are prepped and later must be disposed of, a ticket must be placed for removal.
Wash the stir bar with MilliQ Water.
Clean powder balance and wipe down stir plates used for solution prep.

Rinse all beakers, graduated cylinders, and other equipment used to prepare ACSF solutions with MilliQ Water only (No Detergent). Spray down with 70% Ethanol, and invert all beakers and graduated cylinders and leave on clean absorbent pad to air dry.
Decontaminate surfaces where Picrotoxin was handled using a 10% bleach solution.
Technical Information:
Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid III (ACSF.III) has a shelf life of one week, stored at 4°C.
Use within one week from the day it is made, or at the discretion of the investigator.
